meta.title: Self-hosted media management and processing
meta.description: surgeMedia centralises your images and media, transforms them on demand and delivers them to your applications through a secure API.

hero.title: Your media, under your control.
hero.description: Centralise the images of all your projects, crop, resize and optimise them on demand, then deliver them to your applications through a secure API, on your own infrastructure.

example.caption: An image transformation in a single URL

features.title: Everything you need to serve your media

transform.title: On-demand transformations
transform.description: Cropping, resizing, WebP or AVIF conversion and compression, generated on first request and then cached.

api.title: Secure API
api.description: Per-project access tokens, fine-grained permissions and allowed CORS origins for each application.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.description: Your files and data stay with you: SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL, local or object storage.

sdk.title: Ready-to-use components
sdk.description: Optimised images, galleries and uploads for Vue, React and Svelte, whatever your framework.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to access the surgeMedia administration.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Accounts are created by an administrator of your organisation.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.invalid: The information entered is not valid.
errors.unexpected: Sign-in failed. Please try again in a moment.

bootstrapWarning.title: Bootstrap credentials still set
bootstrapWarning.description: Your administrator account exists: remove NUXT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL and NUXT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the server environment, then restart it.

upcoming.title: Section in progress
upcoming.description: This section will be available in an upcoming release. Your role already grants you access to it.

media.title: Media
media.description: Upload, organise and transform the media of your projects.

projects.title: Projects and API
projects.description: Manage projects, their allowed origins (CORS) and the API integration.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: Create and revoke the tokens your applications use to call the API.

users.title: Users
users.description: Create your team's accounts and assign them a role.

DEVELOPER.description: Management of media, access tokens and APIs.
